grids.prompt: Create one square image: a 3x3 grid of 9 separate square portrait photos of different fictional people, all cells exactly equal size, separated by thin straight white lines, no outer border. Each cell is a casual phone photo of one person sitting by a window in a cozy cafe, soft natural window light from one side, genuine laughing smile, head and shoulders, realistic skin texture, natural colors, like a social media profile picture. Each cell shows only that one person. No text, no names, no numbers, no logos, no letters on clothing, no watermark.
